governing_question: What is the minimum vertically aggregated state representation that preserves hydrologically relevant Richards-column memory, where must that state information be located, and what physically justified closure is sufficient to propagate it?

error_decomposition.state_information_error: Future Reference response ambiguity among fine states that are indistinguishable in a frozen reduced state coordinate. No candidate propagation closure is involved.
error_decomposition.closure_error: Flux/response discrepancy caused by an inter-layer or lower-boundary closure while the reduced state representation and initialization are held fixed. One-step/teacher-forced diagnostics are preferred before propagated comparison.
error_decomposition.numerical_discretization_error: Difference caused by solving Richards on the same coarse partition and/or by time integration of an otherwise fixed closure. Same-partition CoRichards and temporal refinement are comparators, not Layer-ROM closure evidence.

representation_matrix.design_rule: Primary nonuniform family is nested so extra state can be interpreted as incremental information. Uniform controls are generated by rounded equal-cell cuts on the frozen 16x10 cm base grid.

L2.rationale: aggressive lower-active-zone challenge from historical B01 state evidence

L3.rationale: historical B01 minimum zero-collision design candidate; frozen here only as a hypothesis

L4.rationale: nested robustness control adding one lower-zone storage

L6.rationale: prospectively frozen nested extension that adds mid-column memory while preserving lower-zone refinement; not selected from Layer-ROM response results

later_state_families: layer storage plus one or more gradient/moment coordinates
representation_matrix.expansion_rule: Do not add a new state family until the frozen storage-only matrix identifies a specific future-response ambiguity or closure mechanism that the added coordinate is intended to resolve.

C_LARE_TAYLOR.description: adjacent-layer Taylor gradient and opposite-thickness weighted interface conductivity

C_DARCY_CENTER.description: invert each layer mean water content to a representative pressure head; compute center-to-center Darcy gradient; use a declared thickness-aware harmonic conductivity mean; no empirical correction
C_DARCY_CENTER.qualification: equation/limit identities and sign convention must be persisted before trajectory execution

C_QS_RECON.description: reconstruct a physically admissible within-layer pressure profile satisfying layer storage before evaluating interface flux

C_REFERENCE_FACE_ORACLE.state: same frozen layer storages plus fine Reference flux supplied externally
C_REFERENCE_FACE_ORACLE.description: teacher-forced Reference face flux to separate propagation/state loss from closure error

profile: pressure-head profile only as secondary diagnostic

purpose_views.GW-R: regional groundwater/recharge; emphasize coupling-window and longer-horizon exchange and signed bias
purpose_views.GW-D: dynamic shallow-groundwater response; emphasize instantaneous flux, sign and reversals
purpose_views.AG-WB: agricultural water balance/drought; not executable in Phase A because ET/root uptake excluded
purpose_views.EVT: fast infiltration/ponding/runoff; outside Phase A boundary capability
purpose_views.SCI-P: profile/process research; retain profile and local transient diagnostics

falsification_rules: Any candidate trajectory with nonfinite state, physical bound failure, hidden mass correction, or absolute transaction mass residual above 1e-12 cm fails structurally.
A representation is not declared sufficient merely because current-state reconstruction error is small; future-response ambiguity under identical forcing is required.
If a same-dimension smart partition is not consistently more informative than its uniform control on independent future-response evidence, no placement advantage is claimed.
If adding state dimension produces no reproducible reduction in future-response ambiguity across independent histories, the extra state is not retained on information grounds.
If state ambiguity is small but propagated flux sign/reversal errors remain large, classify the deficit as closure/propagation rather than state-information failure.
If same-partition CoRichards differs materially from fine R16, do not attribute the full Layer-ROM discrepancy to closure.
No observed candidate error becomes an application acceptance threshold.

stage_A_retrospective_replay.primary_output: collision/near-collision counts for the eight frozen storage representations at the inherited Reference diagnostic floor and fixed multiples

boundary_regimes.bottom: existing Reference fixed-flux boundary route with frozen externally prescribed bottom flux
boundary_regimes.purpose: independent state-memory test without lower-head closure

boundary_regimes.bottom: existing Reference prescribed lower pressure-head route, fixed within each history
boundary_regimes.purpose: groundwater-head-controlled laboratory only; no production coupling or shallow-groundwater application claim

new_independent_reference_plan.forcing_histories_rule: Exact amplitudes, segment lengths and future-probe bank must be committed before the first new Reference trajectory is executed. No amplitude is tuned from candidate results.
new_independent_reference_plan.future_probe_rule: Collision/adversarial pairs may be selected from the new state library, but future response must use an independently frozen common forcing bank and horizons.

comparator_policy.same_partition_corichards: attempt only under a separately bound reduced-model numerical policy; numerical unavailability is reported, not repaired from candidate fidelity results
comparator_policy.existing_lare: standard closure comparator where boundary authority exactly matches
comparator_policy.FMC: use only where exact canonical FMC authority supports the regime; no D28/D30/D31 semantics invented
comparator_policy.performance: defer until representation and closure are frozen on fidelity grounds

hard_nonclaims: no statement that LARE is the preferred closure
